stages.label: Meadow and pond
stages.description: Lay the meadow, dig the pond in the widest clearing and pave a ring around every trunk foot.

stages.label: Trunks and pods
stages.description: Raise each trunk as a circulation core, grow a branching strut out of it and seat a pod on the strut.

stages.label: Branches and walkways
stages.description: Each pod opens onto its trunk core through a short branch; walkway tubes join pods of neighbouring trunks.

stages.label: Rule-driven growth
stages.description: Rules wander footpaths across the meadow and plant reeds at the pond edge.

stages.label: Constraint checks
stages.description: Walk from the meadow edge up every trunk core and along every branch; follow load paths through the struts.

stages.label: Architectural detailing
stages.description: Shrubs on the meadow, lanterns on walkways and paths, crowns of foliage on the trunks.
